methods.source_location: Experimental technique, paragraph 4: Pt internal pressure standard

methods.scope: Ruby chips at sample edges were used as a secondary calibrant; the exact ruby scale is not identified.

recalculation.notes: The exact Pt EOS is executable, but the article does not tabulate row-wise Pt volumes and temperatures.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the author-hosted version of record; LitCurate was used only as a discovery lead.

primary_source_check.finding: Six diffraction images at 19.7-45.8 GPa support a source-owned BM3 fit with adopted V0 and K0' and fitted K0=255(5) GPa. Rows 408-409 in LitCurate are incomplete literature comparisons, not additional fits by this paper.

primary_data_check.finding: Six unique Figure 2a marker centers and plotted 1-sigma error-bar halfwidths recovered from the author-hosted vector PDF: five tetragonal refinements and the open cubic refinement at 19.7 GPa. Volumes derive from plotted V/V0 using the source-adopted V0=45.58 A3. These remain approximate plot-derived observations, not an original numerical table or original regression weights. The pressure observations use paragraph 7 printed values; digitized horizontal readings remain separate.

figure_digitization_check.finding: Diagnostic fits using the plotted errors agree with published K0=255(5) GPa. Weight choice changes the answer; no original-fit reproduction or original parameter-error reproduction is asserted. Published parameters and errors remain unchanged.
figure_digitization_check.pressure_coordinates: Six pressures printed in paragraph 7; volumes and source error bars digitized from Figure 2a.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: abstract; paragraphs 4-10; Figure 2.
parameter_provenance.V0: Paragraph 10: 45.58 A^3 adopted from Wang et al. (1996).
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: The paper states that error bars are one standard deviation; no parameter covariance or regression weights are published.

source_lineage.role: tetragonal diffraction observations and EOS fit
